EmailTemplate.subject: Flywire expands payment options in Latin America
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Flywire Expands Payment Options in Latin America We’re thrilled to announce we have met a growing demand of Latin American students studying abroad by expanding our payment options.
Flywire’s new payment options include PSE, Pago Efectivo and Servipag. Popular payment methods within their respective countries, each of these options provide a familiar user experience. Additionally, confirmation of payment happens within minutes, changing payment status to guaranteed.
Pagos Seguros en Línea (PSE) is a payment platform that enables Colombian payers to easily make online bank transfers. They are connected to 19 banks in the country and allow the account owners to complete transactions in a matter of seconds with a few clicks. Some of the main advantages of PSE include:
- Eliminating the need for the payer to add beneficiary information, reducing errors
- Removing any non-resident (NR) status issues that have made it difficult for Colombian payers to send funds via Flywire in the past
Pago Efectivo is a payments platform that aims to support institutions collecting online payments by offering Peruvian payers the possibility of paying via cash or bank transfer (online and offline). They are connected to 14 banks in Peru and thousands of kiosks across the country to support cash payments. Some of the key benefits of PE include:
- Making it easier to pay via bank transfer due to our account being a non-resident account (NRA)
- Reducing the complexity of making payments online
Servipag is a payment network backed by Banco de Chile that supports Chileans in paying any type of service or bill. With the Servipag Reference Code, payers can choose to pay online via bank transfer (18 banks supported), debit card, credit card, retails card and ServipagGo, or offline at one of thousands of kiosks, ATMs or Banco de Chile branches with cash or card. Some of the main benefits of Servipag include:
- Six different ways of receiving the payment, both online and offline
- All payment-related information is within the reference code, so the payer does not need our beneficiary details to complete the payment
